description: Add comprehensive 'El Niño Impact Dashboard' section to HomeScreen (client-side mobile app) with 6 sub-sections: (1) Official Advisories filtered for heat/drought/weather, (2) Hospital Monitoring showing 7-day trend chart of heat stroke, heat exhaustion, dehydration, and respiratory cases, (3) BFP Wildfire Operations listing fire incidents, (4) CDRRMO El Niño Response displaying relief operations timeline, (5) Agricultural Damages showing crop damage reports, and (6) Utility Interruption Schedule combining water and power outages. Use orange/red heat theme, Recharts for trend visualization, real-time Supabase subscriptions for live updates, mobile-responsive layout, and dark mode support. This feature depends on FEAT-001 (RLS fix) being complete so anonymous clients can read operational data.
steps: Create new component src/components/ElNinoMonitoringCard.jsx as reusable card wrapper with props: title, icon, data[], loading, emptyMessage, children. Style with cardStyle pattern, dark mode support, Framer Motion fadeIn animation, header with icon+title+timestamp, content area, optional 'View All' link. ~150 lines.

Open src/screens/HomeScreen.jsx, locate line 650 (after weather forecast section), insert new section header: '🌡️ El Niño Impact Dashboard' with orange gradient background, subtitle 'Real-time monitoring of heat-related incidents and utility status'

Add state management at top of HomeScreen: const [elNinoData, setElNinoData] = useState({advisories:[], hospitalRecords:[], bfpOperations:[], cdrrmoOperations:[], agricultureDamages:[], waterInterruptions:[], powerInterruptions:[]}); const [elNinoLoading, setElNinoLoading] = useState(true);

Add useEffect to fetch all El Niño data on mount: parallel queries to supabase.from('advisories').select('*').eq('status','Published').limit(3), supabase.from('hospital_daily_records').select('heat_stroke_cases, heat_exhaustion_cases, dehydration_cases, respiratory_cases, record_date').order('record_date', {ascending:false}).limit(7), supabase.from('bfp_operations').select('*').eq('operation_type','fire_incident').limit(5), supabase.from('cdrrmo_daily_operations').select('*').limit(7), supabase.from('agriculture_damage_reports').select('*').limit(8), supabase.from('water_interruptions').select('*').eq('status','ongoing').limit(5), supabase.from('power_interruptions').select('*').gte('interruption_date','today').limit(5). Set elNinoData state and elNinoLoading=false.

Add sub-section 1: Official Advisories using ElNinoMonitoringCard, filter client-side for category='Weather' OR title/content contains 'el niño'/'heat'/'drought' (case-insensitive), display card list with title, urgency badge (red=High, orange=Medium, yellow=Low), published date, content preview (120 chars), AlertTriangle icon

Add sub-section 2: Hospital Monitoring using ElNinoMonitoringCard with HeartPulse icon (#dc2626 red), display summary cards grid (Total Heat Stroke last 7 days, Heat Exhaustion, Dehydration, Respiratory), add Recharts LineChart with 4 lines (heat_stroke_cases, heat_exhaustion_cases, dehydration_cases, respiratory_cases) over 7 days, X-axis=record_date formatted as M/D, Y-axis=case count, colors: dark red, orange, blue, gray

Add sub-section 3: BFP Wildfire Operations using ElNinoMonitoringCard with Flame icon (#ea580c orange-red), display list of fire incidents with date, location, personnel deployed, fire trucks, casualties, property damage formatted as ₱###,###.##, status badge (Active=red, Contained=orange, Resolved=green)

Add sub-section 4: CDRRMO El Niño Response using ElNinoMonitoringCard with Tent icon (#16a34a green), display timeline cards with date, relief operations count, evacuations, families assisted, ambulance dispatches, remarks. Add Recharts BarChart showing daily relief_operations + evacuations_conducted over 7 days

Add sub-section 5: Agricultural Damages using ElNinoMonitoringCard with Sprout icon (#65a30d lime green), filter client-side for cause IN ('drought','heat_stress','water_shortage'), display grid of damage cards with crop_type, barangay, area_affected_hectares, damage_percentage, estimated_loss_value formatted as ₱###,###, status badge. Add summary: total hectares affected, total estimated loss

Add sub-section 6: Utility Interruption Schedule using ElNinoMonitoringCard with Droplet+Zap icons (gradient blue→yellow), combine water_interruptions and power_interruptions queries, display timeline with date, type badge (Water=blue, Power=yellow), affected barangays/feeders, duration, households affected. Color code critical interruptions (>1000 households OR >8 hours) as red. Sort chronologically (soonest first)

Add real-time Supabase subscriptions in separate useEffect: subscribe to postgres_changes on hospital_daily_records, bfp_operations, cdrrmo_daily_operations, agriculture_damage_reports, water_interruptions, power_interruptions, advisories. On insert/update, re-fetch relevant data. Cleanup subscriptions on unmount.

Style for mobile responsiveness: single column stack on <768px, 2-column grid on tablet, 3-column grid on desktop where appropriate. All charts wrapped in ResponsiveContainer. 16px gap between cards, 24px section padding. Icons 20px size. Dark mode: adjust card backgrounds (#18181b dark, #ffffff light), text colors, chart line colors for visibility.

Test in dev mode: npm run dev (unauthenticated), navigate to HomeScreen, verify El Niño section displays with 6 sub-sections, each showing data OR empty state with icon+message. Add sample hospital record via admin dashboard, confirm it appears on HomeScreen within 2 seconds (real-time subscription working)
Test responsiveness: resize browser to mobile width (375px), confirm all cards stack vertically, charts remain readable. Toggle dark mode via theme switcher, confirm colors adapt correctly.
Run npm run build and confirm 0 errors, no console warnings
acceptance_criteria: ElNinoMonitoringCard component created at src/components/ElNinoMonitoringCard.jsx with reusable structure (title, icon, loading, emptyMessage, children props)
HomeScreen has 'El Niño Impact Dashboard' section header with flame/sun icon and orange gradient background below weather forecast section
Official Advisories sub-section filters for heat/drought/weather-related advisories and displays top 3 with urgency badges
Hospital Monitoring shows 7-day trend chart with 4 lines (heat stroke, heat exhaustion, dehydration, respiratory) using Recharts LineChart, plus summary cards for total cases last 7 days
BFP Wildfire Operations lists fire incidents with date, location, personnel, fire trucks, casualties, property damage in PHP currency format, status badges color-coded
CDRRMO El Niño Response displays relief operations timeline with date, operations count, evacuations, families assisted, ambulance dispatches, plus BarChart showing 7-day operations trend
Agricultural Damages grid shows crop_type, barangay, hectares affected, damage %, estimated loss in PHP, filtered for drought/heat stress causes, with summary totals at top
Utility Interruption Schedule combines water + power interruptions in single chronological timeline, color-coded by type (blue=water, yellow=power, red=critical), displays affected areas and duration
All 6 sub-sections have empty states with appropriate icons and messages when no data available ('No active advisories', 'No recent hospital data', etc.)
Real-time subscriptions working: new records inserted via admin dashboard appear on client HomeScreen within 2 seconds without page refresh
Mobile responsive layout: all cards stack vertically on viewport <768px width, charts remain readable, no horizontal overflow
Dark mode support: colors adapt correctly in both light and dark themes (card backgrounds, text, chart lines, icons)
Last updated timestamps display in local time format (e.g., 'January 4, 2025 14:30') at bottom of each sub-section
Build passes with 0 errors: npm run build completes successfully
No console errors or warnings in browser DevTools when viewing HomeScreen as unauthenticated user
verification: npm run build (must complete with 0 errors)
npm run dev, open browser in incognito/private mode (unauthenticated user), navigate to http://localhost:5173
Scroll down HomeScreen to El Niño Impact Dashboard section, verify section header displays with orange gradient
Verify all 6 sub-sections render: Advisories, Hospital Monitoring (chart visible), Wildfire Operations, CDRRMO Response (chart visible), Agricultural Damages, Utility Interruptions
If data exists: verify charts render correctly, numbers format properly (PHP currency, dates), status badges color-coded. If no data: verify empty states display with icons and messages.

Open admin dashboard in separate tab (authenticated), add new hospital record with heat_stroke_cases=5, record_date=today, save. Switch back to client HomeScreen tab, verify new record appears in Hospital Monitoring chart within 2 seconds (real-time subscription).
Resize browser window to mobile width (375px), verify all cards stack vertically, no horizontal scroll, charts adjust size via ResponsiveContainer
Toggle dark mode (theme switcher in nav), verify colors adapt: card backgrounds change to #18181b, text remains readable, chart lines visible on dark background
Check browser console: no errors, no RLS policy violations, no failed queries
Verify 'Last updated' timestamps at bottom of sub-sections display current local time
